component.name: xanatoo
component.summary: Interactive hypertext document editor and browser

description.p: xanatoo is a lightweight, realtime document composition engine in the spirit of HyperCard, Xanadu and the Canon Cat. Documents are edited live with immediate visual feedback, and every passage is addressable.

ul.li: Markdown, Org and Gemtext documents with foldable sections and an outline
Split view, tabs and floating document windows
Read-only views of web pages, feeds, Wikipedia, Gemini, Hacker News, Reddit, Lemmy and Nostr
Drafts of unsaved edits are kept in a local revision store
